description: Change the preferences that drive job matching — desired roles, seniority, skills, salary range, locations, timezone flexibility. Only the fields you pass are changed. Requires a token with profile access. Read them with get_profile first and confirm the change with the user before writing.

desired_roles.description: Job titles to match on, e.g. ["Backend Engineer"].

experience_level.description: Seniority, e.g. "senior". Call get_profile to see the current value.

preferred_locations.description: Regions or countries, e.g. ["Europe"]. See list_job_locations.

name: update_job_preferences
title: Update job-search preferences
